The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1fbf2cdd8ba384fa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let (D, d, k) be a complete Noetherian local domain of dimension h > 0, with perfect residue field k of characteristic p > 0. There exist a D-algebra C and a function λ, with values in [0, ∞], on C-modules annihilated by some power of d, with the following properties. 1. The function is additive on short exact sequences and vanishes on the zero module. Direct sums, sums, and directed colimits of modules of length zero have length zero whenever a fixed power of d annihilates all modules under consideration. 2. For every system of parameters z1, . . . , zh of D and every integer a ≥ 1, λ C/(za 1 , . . . , za h)C  = ah e((z1, . . . , zh), D), λHi(za 1 , . . . , za h; C) = 0 (i > 0). In particular, the number µ = λ(C/(z1, . . . , zh)C) is positive and finite. 3. If H is d-primary, then ( λ(C/HC) = eHK(H, D), char D = p, λ(C/HC) ≤ e(H, D), char D = 0. The same zero-length stability applies to modules killed by a fixed power of an ideal extended from any d-primary ideal of D.
